newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer but gas oil eases.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer but gas oil eases.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Tuesday but weaker futures left outright gas oil prices easier, traders said.
Gasoline was firmer supported by good U.S. demand, but transatlantic trade was limited because of scarce tonnage.
Naphtha prices continued to strengthen as firm gasoline prices and perceptions of fresh demand fuelled a bullish mood.
Gas oil eased $1 in line with futures. Cargo and barge premiums were steady, supported by strong heating oil demand.
High and low sulphur cracked fuel oil gained strength after a bullish bunker cargo sale late on Monday.
